newsitem.title: UK: British Polythene says disposes assets.
newsitem.headline: British Polythene says disposes assets.

text.p: British Polythene Industries (BPI) said on Thursday it had disposed a part of the packaging business known as HPC, acquired in August from Sidlaw Group Plc, to Hanfare Protective Clothing Ltd.

In a statement, BPI said it had made the disposal for a consideration payable in cash of 1.38 million stg plus stock at an agreed valuation. The assets disposed were part of HPC which BPI had bought from Sidlaw for 2.2 million stg plus stock at agreed valuation.
The HPC business covered operations in Birmingham, Brentford and Bicester.
Since the acquisition, BPI had closed down the Bicester site and transferred a part of production from Brentford to Birmingham.
BPI said its disposal to Hanfare comprised some fixed assets, including freehold property and some small businesses at Brentford.
"The proceeds will be used to reduce Group borrowings," BPI said in the statement. --London Newsroom +44-171-542 7717
